name: unpaged-codex
description: Review Unpaged plans from the same Codex task with durable comment routing and explicit human acceptance.

interface.shortDescription: Review visual plans in your Codex task.
interface.longDescription: Create a visual plan, receive board comments in its assigned Codex task, and revise until the owner explicitly accepts the current plan. Includes durable local delivery state and visible recovery limits.
defaultPrompt: Create an Unpaged plan and listen for its review comments.
